whoItsFor: Developers and teams who want to query technical books, internal docs, brand guidelines, research papers, or specs from inside their coding agent instead of searching PDFs or re-reading them. Users of Claude Code, Codex, Copilot CLI, Amp, OpenCode, OpenClaw, or Hermes Agent are the target.
useCases: Turn a technical book PDF into a skill and ask it questions while coding, such as `/my-book replication`
Fold a team's docs folder (ADRs, runbooks, onboarding guides) into one queryable skill
Merge a stack of research papers and personal notes into a single unified skill that updates as new material arrives
